title: unified-rollouts: canary + A/B + shadow trafﬁc autorollback enhancements
author: Marta Alvarez
release_notes: Improve autorollback safety and observability for canary/A-B/shadow rollouts: add metric quorum, per-stage quarantine, better telemetry tags, and e2e stability guards.
description: Context: Users need safer automated rollback for mixed-mode rollouts (canary, A/B, shadow) after several incidents where noisy metrics and transient infra blips caused unnecessary rollbacks. This PR adds quorum-based metric evaluation, per-stage quarantine windows, and improved telemetry to reduce false positives while keeping fast rollback on real regressions. Motivation: reduce customer impact from spurious rollbacks, provide clearer signals for SRE and product teams, and unify safety guards across rollout modes. Summary of changes: 1) rollout/autorollback: add composite metric quorum evaluator (supports threshold + quorum over independent signals). 2) rollout/engine: introduce per-stage quarantine window that pauses automated progression for a configurable duration when marginal regressions are detected. 3) observability: tag rollback events with rollout_id, stage, experiment_id (for A/B), and probe_quorum results; emit debug-level traces for decision path. 4) e2e & unit tests: add simulations for noisy signal scenarios and integration test for canary->shadow transitions. 5) docs: rollout strategy guidance and upgrade notes for operators. Backwards compatibility: new config fields default to conservative values (quorum disabled, quarantine window = 0) so existing rollout behavior is preserved until operators opt-in. Migration: schema migration for rollout policies is additive and handled by controller during reconcile. Checklist: - [x] design review (ENG-2045) - [x] unit tests added - [x] integration/e2e tests added - [x] load tests run on perf-lab - [x] docs updated - [x] feature flagged for gradual rollout Testing & CI: initial CI run failed on a flaky test in rollout/simulator; flaky test hardened and re-run. All checks passed on the final run. Manual QA: ran staged canary with synthetic regression and noisy probes in perf-canary; observed correct quarantine and rollback behavior. Rollout plan: feature-gated behind rollout.autorollback.v2; enable in staging for 2 weeks with canary traffic at 10% then 30% then 100% if stable; abort criteria documented in release notes. Risks & mitigations: risk of extended quarantine delaying rollback on true regressions; mitigated by configurable max-delay and emergency manual abort API. Observability improvements should help debugging if incidents occur. Related PRs & work items: follow-ups planned for advanced composite metrics and UI controls (ENG-2107).
